page.layout: One page of text, single column; below the text a catchword "CAPI-" at the right and a woodcut ornament. No margin notes. Running head at top.

main_text.p: panem, quem nos frangimus, appellauerit suum corpus, & iusserit, vt nos hunc ipsum panem ad certam sui pro nobis traditi corporis recordationem corporaliter & oraliter edamus: quòd item S. Paulus hunc ipsum panem, vt testimonium & probationem spiritualis communionis corporis Christi adduxerit, id in verbo Dei expressum inuenimus: quòd autem Christus dixerit, IN vel SVB hoc pane corpus suum essentialiter latere, & vnà cum hoc pane corporaliter per os in corpora nostra ingredi: vel etiam, quòd hæc verba Christi glossa & interpretatio sit vera & idonea, hoc adhuc illis, qui id affirmant, ex verbo Dei demonstrandum restat.

page.notes: The running head reads "QVÆSTIONES" with a decorated Q. The catchword "CAPI-" is partly cut. A woodcut ornament sits below the text; no text in it. Page number 412 printed at top left. Some words in the first line are faint; "appellauerit" and "expressum" read as printed.
